request_claims: The dump contains 5,879 packed geometry GIF tags with descriptor nibbles [2,1,4], whose register sequence is STQ, RGBAQ, XYZF2.
PCSX2's packed STQ/RGBA/XYZF2 handler consumes three qwords per vertex in that exact order and forwards XYZF2.Skip() to VertexKick.
For packed XYZF2, ADC is bit 15 of U32[3] and the GS handler uses that bit to determine whether to skip the vertex kick.
The race-frame packet decode contains 135,032 XYZF2 vertices, with ADC set for 67,433 and clear for 67,599.
The primitive-type counts and material-state values from this dump are frame-wide and do not prove that any specific car used a particular tag, texture, alpha, or filter value.

evidence.text: At PCSX2 commit 81526d4dc7cc70e4ae75abb35a789417456c6d43, GSRegs.h enum GIF_REG_STQ=0x02, GIF_REG_RGBAQ=0x01, GIF_REG_XYZF2=0x04. GIFPacked STQ fields float S,T,Q. GIFPacked XYZF2 fields X,Y,Z(24),F(8),ADC bit 15; Skip() is U32[3] & 0x8000.

At the same PCSX2 commit, GSState.cpp GIFPackedRegHandlerSTQRGBAXYZF2 asserts size divisible by 3; reads r[0] STQ, r[1] RGBA, r[2] XYZF2; invokes VertexKick(r[2].XYZF2.Skip()); and advances r by 3. GIFPackedRegHandlerXYZF2 computes skip = adc || r->XYZF2.Skip() and passes skip to VertexKick.

Pinned single-frame PCSX2 GSDump decoded completely to EOF, with 5,879 packed geometry tags whose descriptor nibble sequence is [2,1,4]. The deterministic decoder finds 135,032 vertex records, 67,433 ADC set, 67,599 clear. Primitive raw type 4 (triangle strip): 2,799 tags; raw type 5 (triangle fan): 3,080 tags. Capture is one game frame with a car visibly present, but the counts are global; no tags have been assigned to a specific car or material.
